outline.heading: When each format is the honest one

points.text: Text digest with citations — when you need to master the material and cite it downstream: at work, in a text, in an argument.
One session — one format, chosen for the scenario.

points: You use a text digest with citations when you need to master the material.
This format helps you cite it downstream at work, in a text, or in an argument.
You use one format for each session, chosen for the scenario.
